title: Protocol for investigating working memory modulation of visual signal processing in the monkey extrastriate cortex using local field potentials.
abstract: Here, we present a protocol for investigating the impact of working memory on visual signal processing on the extrastriate cortex of monkeys using local field potentials (LFPs). We describe steps for conducting a spatial working memory task while recording LFPs and spiking activity from middle temporal (MT) neurons. We then detail procedures for preprocessing LFP data and subsequent analysis using inter-trial coherence (ITC) to measure visual signal arrival times. For complete details on the use and execution of this protocol, please refer to Roshanaei et al.<sup>1</sup>.
